rule.statement: The Judges of the Civil Appellate High Court did not misdirect themselves by failing to consider the fact that the learned Trial Judge before whom the factual evidence was led has duly evaluated the evidence and arrived at her judgment.
rule.supporting_quote: Have the Judges of the Civil Appellate High Court misdirected themselves by failing to consider the fact that the learned Trial Judge before whom the factual evidence was led has duly evaluated the evidence and arrived at her judgment dated 23.1.2012?
